completeness.why: applyWeekendRule(date, rule) now decides both whether (skipWeekend) and how (mode); getNextDate keeps only its site-specific noSkipWeekend guard and getUpcomingDates passes its config straight through, but both createScheduleList sites still wrap the call in their own `skipWeekend ? ... : nextBaseDate` ternary, so the enable decision is still taken locally there (twice).

interface.why: A single (date, {skipWeekend, weekendSolveMode}) parameter fits the real variation and noSkipWeekend stays as the one site-only option, but instead of letting each caller map its own field name the diff renames the parsed schedule's weekendSolve to weekendSolveMode in parseRecurDate, silently erasing a listed inconsistency rather than making it explicit, and the template callers keep a redundant outer skipWeekend check.

disguised_duplication.where: No reshaped copy: the old getDateWithSkippedWeekend is replaced, not kept beside the new helper; the leftover duplication is the redundant skipWeekend ternary kept verbatim at the two createScheduleList sites in server/budget/schedule-template.ts, which is undisguised.
